Release v0.9.1 (#1431)

* fix(comfyui): add HTTP status check and polling resilience for RunPod API (#1424)

* fix(comfyui): add HTTP status check and polling resilience for RunPod API

Check res.ok before returning RunPod status response to prevent HTML error
pages (502 Bad Gateway) from propagating as raw strings. Add consecutive
error tracking with exponential backoff and fail-fast after 10 consecutive
failures to avoid hitting Vercel's 800s timeout.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(comfyui): check webhook completion before aborting polling

When RunPod status API is unreachable, check the DB to see if the webhook
has already processed the result before refunding tokens and failing. This
prevents false-negative failures when the status API is down but the
webhook path delivered results successfully.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): render TextV2 objects inside frames (#1426)

TextV2 was completely missing from the frame child rendering pipeline,
causing text to become invisible when dragged into a frame. Add TextV2Node
rendering branch in frame-node.tsx and wire up selection, drag, and
transform handlers with proper coordinate conversion.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: remove regenerate input image option (#1429)

* feat(canvas): implement FloatingRegenerateContainer and update FloatingQuickActions

- Added FloatingRegenerateContainer component for image regeneration functionality.
- Replaced FloatingImageGenerateContainer with FloatingRegenerateContainer in FloatingQuickActions.
- Updated QuickActionButton rendering logic to simplify the UI.
- Removed unused outputMode translations from multiple language files.

This update enhances the image regeneration capabilities and improves the overall structure of the floating action components.

* refactor(canvas): clean up FloatingMultiImageActions and related components

- Removed unnecessary whitespace and improved formatting for better readability in FloatingMultiImageActions.
- Updated dependencies in FloatingRegenerateContainer to use consistent variable names.
- Simplified rendering logic in FloatingQuickActions for clarity.
- Added missing import in QuickActionButton to maintain code consistency.

These changes enhance the maintainability and readability of the floating action components, aligning with best practices for clean code.

* fix(canvas): allow multi-selected frame children to escape frame boundary (#1427)

* fix(canvas): allow multi-selected frame children to escape frame boundary

- Remove allObjectsInPanel guard and parentId skip from getBoundingBox()
  so frame children participate in multi-selection
- Add handleDragStart that detaches frame children (clears parentId,
  removes from frame.children) so they render at root level during drag
- Add updateFrameContainment calls in handleDragEnd to re-evaluate
  containment after drag completes
- Add isDraggingChild safety net in FrameNode: global pointerup listener
  resets stuck state when dragend is missed (e.g. pointer released outside
  canvas)
- Show semi-transparent (0.3 opacity) overflow preview for single-selected
  frame children via SelectedNodeInPanel ghost copies
- Fix ToolCase undefined crash by replacing with Wrench icon
- Add 6 multi-object containment unit tests

* fix(canvas): show floating toolbar for multi-selected frame children (#1428)

useMultiSelectBounds was treating all objects with parentId as panel
children, returning null bounds and hiding the floating toolbar.
Now only skip objects whose parent is a Panel; frame children
participate in bounds calculation normally.

* fix(canvas): prevent ghost copy from intercepting drag events on frame children

Wrap single-select ghost copies in <Group listening={false}> for frame
children so the semi-transparent overflow preview doesn't block clicks
and drags on the original object inside the frame.

* fix(canvas): prevent ghost copy event interception and darken frame background

- Wrap frame child ghost copies in <Group listening={false}> so the
  semi-transparent overflow preview doesn't block drag on the original
- Increase FRAME_DEFAULT_FILL opacity from 0.05 to 0.5 so objects
  beneath a frame are visually distinct from frame contents

* fix(canvas): only render frame child ghost copy when object overflows frame

Skip ghost copy rendering when the object is fully contained within
the frame boundary. Ghost copies are only needed as overflow preview
for the portion extending beyond the frame.

* fix(canvas): skip multi-select ghost copies for frame children

Frame children multi-select is handled by MultiSelectionGroup, not
SelectedNodeInPanel. Skip the multi-select ghost copy path entirely
when parentType is 'frame' to avoid duplicate rendering.

* fix(canvas): render selected objects on top of frames

- Sort canvasObjects so selected objects render last (highest z-order),
  ensuring they stay visible above opaque frame backgrounds during drag
- Set FRAME_DEFAULT_FILL to fully opaque white so objects beneath
  frames are clearly not part of the frame
- Skip multi-select ghost copies for frame children (handled by
  MultiSelectionGroup)
- Only render single-select ghost when object overflows frame boundary

* fix(canvas): selected objects render on top, frame bg transparent when selected

- Sort canvasObjects so selected objects render last (highest z-order),
  visible above opaque frame backgrounds during drag
- Frame background: opaque white when idle, semi-transparent when
  selected so users can see objects being captured underneath
- Set FRAME_DEFAULT_FILL to fully opaque white
- Skip multi-select ghost copies for frame children
- Only render single-select ghost when object overflows frame boundary

* fix(canvas): frame background only transparent during drag, not when selected

Use isDraggingPanel store state instead of isSelected to control frame
background transparency. This ensures the background is opaque when
the frame is selected for export/download, but semi-transparent during
drag so users can see objects being captured underneath.

* fix(canvas): lift frame z-order when its child is selected

When dragging a child from a lower-z-order frame across a higher-z-order
frame, the child was hidden behind the upper frame. The sort now also
promotes frames that contain a selected child to the top of the render
order, matching the existing behavior for standalone selected objects.

* fix: latest ai-tool list by createdAt (#1430)
